## v2.2.6

The x86-64 Linux AppImage is now built on Ubuntu 22.04 instead of Ubuntu 26.04. This fixes startup on systems where JellyPilot or its bundled libraries previously failed to load because `GLIBC_2.38` or `GLIBC_2.43` was unavailable. Download the new AppImage to replace the old one.

The release job checks that the finished AppImage opens a window as an unprivileged user without network access on Ubuntu 22.04. This is a startup check, not a hardware playback certification. The `.deb` keeps its Ubuntu 26.04 baseline; the AppImage change does not lower the `.deb` requirements.
